items.title: Investors seek lower valuation as AI backlash clouds Anthropic IPO plans
items.description: Investor concerns over Anthropic's $1.5 trillion valuation and a broader AI stock sell-off could force the startup to offer a bigger IPO discount or delay its listing.

items.title: Bombay HC plea seeks RBI direction for Tata Sons' stock market listing
items.description: Petitioners argue that Tata Sons must comply with RBI listing norms and have also sought Noel Tata's removal from key positions, citing public interest and governance concerns

items.title: Sagar Defence, Encube Ethicals among 4 firms to secure Sebi's nod for IPOs
items.description: Sagar Defence Engineering, Encube Ethicals, Arjun Jewellers and IFL Finance have received Sebi's approval to launch IPOs, with proposed issues including fresh shares and offers for sale.

items.title: Best-ever Samvat for IPOs: Record ₹2.23 trillion raised, up 19.6%
items.description: India's primary market raised a record ₹2.23 trillion through 375 IPOs in Samvat 2082, with mainboard issues accounting for ₹2.12 trillion and SME offerings for the rest.
